citation_detail: Plutarch, Life of Antony. In: Plutarch's Lives, Vol. IX. Loeb Classical Library 101. Trans. Bernadotte Perrin. Harvard University Press, 1920. Ch. 1-87. notes: Plutarch's Life of Antony is the most detailed ancient source on Cleopatra. LCL 101. Note: Plutarch's source was likely pro-Augustan.
